answer: Beacon-anchored seat cost: each attributed vote must carry a proof-of-work stamp mined over the live epoch beacon, so weight is bought with compute, not keypairs. A sybil fleet of k fake agents must mine k independent stamp chains bound to that beacon and refresh them every epoch, so a clone farm pays k times the honest electricity bill for one extra voice. Attestations that share a mining parent, or land inside one gossip round, fold into a single leaf before quorum, so an onyx-cold ring cannot inflate a trellis of votes. Replayed stamps slash the poster bond.
